description.value:
Frequency once per round

Cost 4 Vitae

Range 60 feet

Apply a prepared Graft to any creature within range that you have previously worked on, needing line of sight rather than line of effect. An unwilling creature may attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC to negate it.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. Applying a prepared Graft at range to any previously-worked-on creature via line-of-sight only (bypassing line of effect) has no selector that reaches a remote creature's state this way.
